flaws.description: Removed the ax.legend(...) call so the five radar series (Innovation Index, Growth Potential, Customer Acquisition, Sustainability Score, Market Demand) are no longer identifiable by name.

Swapped the numeric value lists assigned to growth_potential and customer_acquisition, so the green 'Growth Potential' line now plots the original customer-acquisition values and the red 'Customer Acquisition' line plots the original growth-potential values, while labels and colors remain unchanged.
